item.title: TTT 414: Internet Hoggers
item.description:
Hey everyone! In this episode we discuss how dating has changed - from 1940s politeness to 1990s internet weirdness to todays ridiculousness. It gets hot and heavy. Also we wrap up our coverage of the Eurovision 2015 songs as we discuss songs from Norway, Russia, Spain and Finland. We’ll have much more to say after we watch the finals on May 23rd.

Calgary’s Only Podcast! Calgary’s Best Podcast!

item.title: TTT 392: Never Come Back
item.description:
Eric and Rachelle are back, refreshed and ready to talk shit. We discuss Russia’s answer to Eurovision. Hint: It will probably suck. We also talk about a local radio station capitalizing on tween lack of attention. Good times.

We are Calgary’s best podcast.
